game_title: Compound Combo – Crater Lake Edge Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, a new cooling flasks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 260 points of cooling flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 260 within 42 seconds.
